name: Siam
source:
A mercenary and mentor to Sadaqah and [url=/c74792]Canaan[/url], the latter whom considered him as her friend.

Born [url=/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Bank]west of the Jordan River[/url] 4 years after the [url=/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suez_Crisis]Tripartite Aggression[/url], Siam became a member of the [url=/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palestine_Liberation_Organization]Palestine liberation movement[/url] as a member of [url=/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muammar_Gaddafi]Colonel Gaddafi[/url]'s camp. Once he became a mercenary, he participated in the [url=/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iraq_War]Iraq War[/url] and found a young girl who lost her family, taking her in and naming her Canaan, training her to become a mercenary like him.

[spoiler]Two years later (4 years prior to the events of [I][url=/v1299]428: Shibuya Scramble[/url][/I]), Siam and Canaan took a mission to retrieve prototype samples of the Ua virus, but was ultimately killed by Sadaqah, now named [url=/c74615]Alphard[/url].[/spoiler]
